text:
ashley_support: forwarding customer report — Go SDK stream occasionally returns 'invalid character' or 'unexpected EOF' when decoding partial chunks. they pasted logs:

ashley_support: ```
2026-03-16T09:12:10Z ERROR decode failed: invalid character '}' looking for beginning of object key
2026-03-16T09:12:12Z INFO stream chunk len=73216
2026-03-16T09:12:12Z ERROR stream read error: bufio.Scanner: token too long
```

matt_engineer: are they using our SDK's Stream() wrapper or a custom http client?

ashley_support: using redwood-go v0.6.4 -> calling client.StreamChat(...) from their service running in k8s.

jia_sre: pretty sure this is the classic bufio.Scanner 64k token boundary. when the scanner errors we sometimes resume reading mid-JSON which yields 'invalid character' on unmarshal.

sam_qa: repro steps i used locally:
1) run a local proxy that injects a single large chunk > 70KB
2) call client.StreamChat in a loop
3) observe intermittent decode errors

sam_qa: minimal repro snippet i used:
```go
resp, _ := client.StreamChat(ctx, req)
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
    fmt.Println("chunk:", len(scanner.Bytes()))
    // naive json unmarshal
    var obj map[string]interface{}
    if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &obj); err != nil {
        log.Printf("unmarshal err: %v", err)
    }
}
if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
    log.Printf("scanner err: %v", err)
}
```

matt_engineer: ok that's the pattern. two mitigations: increase scanner buffer or switch to json.Decoder which handles streaming across reads.

jia_sre: recommended quick fix for customers (short term):
```go
scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 256*1024), 5*1024*1024) // bump token limit up to 5MB
```

jia_sre: long term: the SDK should not present chunk boundaries as framing guarantees — we should parse a stream-aware decoder internally and surface complete JSON objects to callers (or expose an io.Reader).

ashley_support: customer asked if this is a regression introduced in 0.7.x -> they said it started after upgrading from 0.6.3 to 0.6.4.

matt_engineer: we did change the server-side aggregator in 0.7.0 to reduce per-chunk overhead which can create larger chunks. that made some consumer code that assumed newline-delimited small JSON chunks break. so yes, upgrade path matters.

matt_engineer: action items: backport a safety change to v0.6.x (patch that uses json.Decoder internally), and prepare a proper fix in v0.8.1 that changes the public Stream API to be robust to large tokens. also add docs + migration note.

stream-bot: created support ticket: #SUP-8421 (owner: ashley_support)

ashley_support: ping @matt_engineer can you draft the PR + include the minimal repro test? customer wants confirmation before we close.

matt_engineer: will open PR today with unit/integration test that simulates >100KB chunks and validates no invalid-json errors. i'll include `scanner.Buffer` as a documented workaround.

jia_sre: also let's add a hosted logs alert that surfaces `bufio.Scanner: token too long` and our internal unmarshal errors so we can proactively contact customers.

ashley_support: thanks team :thumbsup:
